mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises but S&P 500 returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate and high unemployment indicate economic weakness, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Both proxies are low but S&P 500 returns are positive over 20 days more than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening cycle, higher FEDFUNDS leads to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises but returns remain positive more than 50%.

mechanism_narrative: High CPI inflation leads to negative S&P 500 returns as costs rise.
failure_condition: CPI is high but returns are positive more than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: Slow GDP growth indicates economic slowdown, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: GDP growth is slow but returns are positive more than 50%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment without industrial growth indicates inefficiency, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Employment rises but returns are positive more than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts indicate economic expansion, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts are high but returns are negative more than 30%.
